title: Keep opaque user-input option IDs confined to adapters that validate by ID
outcome: Codex question adapters continue to answer by exact labels even if an incoming option includes an unrelated id field; only ID-validating adapters populate the shared opaque option value.
acceptance: Both Codex request_user_input parse paths keep shared UserInputQuestionOption.id unset, or use an equivalent protocol-specific decoding boundary that preserves label-answer semantics.
Behavioral coverage sends a Codex option with an id distinct from its label and confirms the existing label answer is accepted and forwarded correctly; Kimi exact-ID questions retain their behavior.
